load_torch_model: load a pretrained PyTorch model from a GitHub repo or local directory using torch.hub.load
list_hub_entrypoints: list all callable entrypoints defined in a GitHub repo's hubconf.py
download_model_weights: download a serialized PyTorch model weights file from a URL with optional hash verification
get_hub_cache_directory: get or set the Torch Hub cache directory used for storing downloaded models and weights
get_model_documentation: retrieve the docstring of a callable entrypoint defined in a repo's hubconf.py
